Hello, PUBG Esports fans!

The Pick'em Challenge Challenge for the PUBG Global Championship has arrived!

Equipped with epic prizes to earn, lets take a deep dive to learn how to pick'em and win'em!

[h3]PUBG ESPORTS TAB
[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/cc2f167eceba2674b07787e79221dd1b5d16e1c2.png[/img]
Simply jump into the Esports tab by clicking the parachute logo located top right of the main menu. Here, you can learn general information about the PGC 2023 Tournament. You can always click on the button at the bottom left corner to head on to the official PUBG Esports website to see details of the tournament. 

Browse through the Esports tab to participate in Pick'em Challenge!

[h3]PUBG GLOBAL CHAMPIONSHIP 2023 ITEMS
[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/83aea7337d3484b50720398c1e0ddf374f83112e.jpg[/img]

- PGC 2023 Emperor's SET (+ 2 VOTING COUPONS, 70,000 EP)

newsitems.title: Arcade: Survivors Left Behind
newsitems.author: [****] UZI
newsitems.contents:
[img]https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/TFBq2IMM.jpg[/img]

[i]Survive the night, craft your fight.
[/i]
Haven's once radiant skyline is now overshadowed by the monstrous aftermath of Tythonic's Blue Chip.

What were once clones for mass trials have turned into the insatiable Hungers, devouring both the island and its inhabitants.

You were enlisted to clean up this nightmare, and now, just four of you remain.

Scavenge, strategize, and work together to secure your escape and survival!

[h2]General Flow
[/h2][img]https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/PPbFuIJ2.jpg[/img]

Welcome to Survivors Left Behind. Your main goal here is to outlast the relentless wave of Hungers and escape to safety. Follow these steps to ensure your survival:

- Navigate to Arcade.
- Select Survivors Left Behind and start matchmaking.
- Once you're in with your 4-man squad, vote for the stage you wish to play.
- The stage receiving the majority of votes will begin after a countdown.
- Each stage presents varying levels of difficulty.
ㅤㅤ- The difficulty increases from Docks/Industrial Park → Residential Zone A/Industrial Park Outskirts ㅤㅤㅤ→ Steel Mill/Residential Zone B.
ㅤㅤ- Use the materials obtained in each stage to take on the more challenging stages.

[img]https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/mfbRm8sT.jpg[/img]

- Once the stage starts, obtain basic weapons by interacting with the vending machine.
		
[img]https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/DHR0jVkp.jpg[/img]

- Guided missions will appear on your screen's left-side - these are pivotal for your squad's getaway. Ensure each task is accomplished.
- Navigate the stage by finding the correct route while combating the Hungers.
		
[img]https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/atwHmK0e.jpg[/img]

- Fuel the necessary Generators, power them up to unveil the exit, and make your way to safety.

[img]https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/jkf6YXPQ.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hungers[/h2]
[img]https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/nHXLLhz6.jpg[/img]

Beware the Hungers, malevolent creatures thirsting for your lifeblood!

Here's a primer on some of the Hungers you may cross paths with:

- Prototype Hunger
- Caregiver Hunger
- Explosive Disposal Hunger
ㅤㅤ- Uses Grenades.
- Molotov Hunger
ㅤㅤ- Uses Molotovs.
- Red Zone Hunger
ㅤㅤ- Uses Blue Zone Grenades.
- Alpha Hunger
ㅤㅤ- Known for its sudden rushes from afar, this gigantic Hunger will collide into you, causing a knockback and leaving you stunned momentarily.
ㅤㅤ- Tip: If a teammate is stunned, interact with them to revive them quicker.
- Dr. Hunger
ㅤㅤ- Uses a purple chemical for its basic attack, inflicting damage akin to that of Molotovs.
ㅤㅤ- Can render certain Hungers invincible - you can only take them down by targeting Dr. Hunger directly. (Hint: Look for the end of the glowing tentacles connected to the invincible Hungers.)
- Nurse Hunger
ㅤㅤ- Possesses a harrowing scream attack, which can disorient players. If it affects you, you will have a shaky screen.
ㅤㅤ- Tip: If a squad member appears dizzy, interact to stabilize their vision.
- C4 Hunger
ㅤㅤ- Has the sinister skill to carry knocked out players, switching the attached C4 on to then self-detonate.

[h2]Hunger Meter and Status Effect
[/h2][img]https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/AZ9IslIp.jpg[/img]

Facing the Hungers is only one of your challenges; you must also keep an eye on your hunger meter and the potential side effects if neglected.

As the stage progresses, your hunger meter will deplete. To maintain it, you must consume food.

Your hunger status will be visually represented below your health bar through color-coded indicators:

- Blue icon and gauge: Satiated
- Green: Peckish
- Orange: Starving
- Red: Depleted

Failing to address your hunger can result in a series of debilitating effects, which intensify as your hunger grows:
- Inability to sprint
- Trembling hands, impairing your aim
- Blurry vision

Cooperation is key. If a teammate is experiencing any of these conditions, interact with them to help.

[h2]Items and Crafting
[/h2][img]https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/WRYMAHl7.jpg[/img]

Crafting is essential to escape the Hungers. Gather diverse crafting materials, use the Crafting Desk, and boost both your hunger meter and health.

While you can satiate your hunger with individual materials like cabbages, water, and cured pork, specially crafted meals offer a more substantial replenishment.

But sustenance isn't your sole crafting option. Craft items like healing items, throwables, anti-Hunger chemicals, and upgraded weapons.

Available crafting weapons are melee weapons, SMGs, and shotguns. Based on the targeted body part, shotguns carry a distinct probability to induce knockbacks or knock downs.

Regarding ammunition, each Hunger you defeat increases your stockpile.
		
[img]https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/AK4dQeQq.jpg[/img]

Additionally, foster teamwork by sharing crafting materials with teammates. Simply drop materials on the ground for them to collect.

[h2]Recall System
[/h2]Revive your fallen teammates by retrieving their Blue Chips.

Find the yellow PC terminal and interact with it to bring your allies back into the fray.

Each match, players are allowed a maximum of 3 recalls, and multiple teammates can be revived simultaneously.

Once revived, teammates will reappear in a random, safe area, holding all their items, except for ammunition, from before their demise. However, be cautious: they'll return with a depleted hunger meter.

[h2]Carry-over Items
[/h2][img]https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/JQUvpNht.jpg[/img]

Regardless of your match result, unused materials and crafted items (excluding weapons) you have collected will carry over to your inventory for subsequent matches.

Moreover, after successfully clearing a stage, if you're lucky, you may even be able to acquire a bonus weapon or piece of armor.

[h2]Service Schedule
[/h2]PC & Console: October 20, 7 AM - November 6, 7 AM (UTC)

[h2]Gameplay Settings
[/h2]- Map: Haven
- FPP only
- 4-Man Squads only
ㅤㅤ- If your squad isn't full, the system will automatically match you with teammates.
- Teamkill disabled

[h2]Arcade Gameplay
[/h2]- Does not provide XP or gameplay rewards.
- Will not be reflected on the Career page.
- Will not be reflected in your Match History.
- Does not support replays. 

[h2]Special Drops: Be The Last Survivor
[/h2]Your mission to escape is just the beginning! Reap rewards as you progress through each stage of Survivors Left Behind.

[i]※ Event details can be checked via the in-game lobby event page.
[/i]
[img]https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/xK82YJKH.jpg[/img]

[h3]Event Missions
[/h3]- Play 1 match of Survivors Left Behind
- Clear a total of 2 stages in Survivors Left Behind
- Clear the Residential Zone B stage in Survivors Left Behind

[h3]Total Rewards  
[/h3]- Emblem - Biohazard
- Hunter's Chest
- Bunny Academy Sailor Gloves

[h3]Event Schedule
[/h3]PC & Console: October 20, 7 AM - October 31, 7 AM (UTC)

[h2]Partner Drops
[/h2]Don't forget to root for and observe your favorite Partners during this season to earn additional rewards!

For more information on Partner Drops and the full list of participating Partners, visit: https://pubg.com/en/events/partner-drops


- Watch at least 1 hour: Contraband Coupon (x5)
- 2 hours: Contraband Coupon (x5)
- 3 hours: PUBG Varsity Jacket (x1)
	
[img]https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/oJWkwbgN.png[/img]

[h3]Drops Schedule
[/h3]PC & Console: October 20, 7 AM - November 4, 7 AM (UTC)

[h3]Important Notes
[/h3]- Drops are exclusively available through affiliated PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Partners only.
- Rewards can only be claimed during the specified Drops period.
- To be eligible for the rewards, ensure that your KRAFTON ID is linked with your gaming platform and with Twitch or your regional streaming platform.
- For countries/platforms where Drops are unavailable, some of the rewards may be distributed through redeemable codes. Please follow the community channels for more information.

See you in Haven.

newsitems.title: PGC 2023 Tournament Structure Announcement
newsitems.author: [****] UZI
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/83aea7337d3484b50720398c1e0ddf374f83112e.jpg[/img]

Hello, PUBG Esports fans!

As 2023 comes to a close, the season's grand finale - The PUBG Global Championship 2023 approaches! From November 18th to December 3rd, 32 top-notch teams from all over the world will be dropping hot in Bangkok, Thailand. The complete list of participating teams will be available around the end of October as all regional series are completed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/13b78ab7f185719b5e378b23c032fd3c85e83fbb.jpg[/img]

We're thrilled to announce that PGC 2023 will have a live audience for the entire tournament, hosted at the Bangkok Convention Centre (BCC Hall). Keep an eye out for information about tickets and various on-site community events.

Well then, let's dive into the details of the tournament!

[h3]PGC 2023 Tournament Overview
[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/05d160f6858a20e0921cbe55592652a720888f39.png[/img]
Over three intense weeks, more than 128+ players from the 32 elite global teams will battle relentlessly, aiming for the prestigious championship throne.

[h3]PGC 2023 Tournament Structure
[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/7b089e056a32c0d677978beeca0b8ebcdd2e857f.png[/img]
The tournament kicks off on November 18th and culminates on December 3rd. The 32 participating teams will undergo a series of stages, with only half advancing to the Grand Finals.

[h3]Group Stage
[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/b210c1e75880333beec5ae443cecf2e349fe95d7.png[/img]
PGC 2023 takes off with a Group Stage where teams battle it out to grab a better chance for the Grand Finals. 
- Before the Group stage, the teams are divided into TWO groups: Group A & Group B.
- Each group will compete for 2 days, 6 matches per day.
- Based on the outcomes of the Group Stage,
ㅤㅤ- The top 8 teams from each group will be placed in the Winners Bracket
ㅤㅤ- The bottom 8 teams from each group will be placed in the Losers Bracket.

[h3]Winners & Losers Bracket / Last Chance
[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/14910b3ceab5be085fa558b95fb029b9969523dd.png[/img]
After a day of break, the team will go through 3 stages, the Losers & Winners Bracket and the Last Chance.

[h3]Losers Bracket
[/h3]The losers bracket will contain 16 teams from the bottom 8 teams of the Group Stage (Group A & B)
- These 16 teams will compete in a 12-match tournament over 2 days.
- The winning top 8 teams will advance to the Last Chance stage.
- However, the bottom 8 teams of the losers bracket will be ELIMINATED from the tournament.

[h3]Winners Bracket
[/h3]The Winners Bracket will contain 16 teams from the top 8 teams of the Group Stage (Group A & B)
- The Winners Bracket will consist of 12 matches over 2 days.
- The rewards for the winners of the group stage are huge. The top 8 teams in the Winners bracket will be granted a seat directly to the Grand Finals. 
- The remaining 8 teams will be placed into the Last Chance stage for their last shot.

[h3]Last Chance
[/h3]Here, as you can expect, the teams will be given their final chance to secure their tickets to the Grand Finals.
- The Last Chance stage will consist of 12 matches over 2 days.
- The winning top 8 teams will acquire the last 8 tickets to the Grand Finals.
- However, the bottom 8 teams will be ELIMINATED from the tournament.

[h3]Grand Finals
[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/d7cc2f72c3946bf3694556c3dc5ac7d7b29d9857.png[/img]
Commencing on December 1st, the remaining 16 teams will stretch their boundaries in the ultimate showdown. Spread across 3 days with 6 matches daily, the top-performing team will be crowned the Champions of the PUBG GLOBAL CHAMPIONSHIP 2023.

[h3]Prize Pool
[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/8a2a163e99830c9c7d130b090aa1af98c782a640.png[/img]
PGC 2023 boasts an initial prize pool of $2,000,000. Thanks to our crowdfunding initiative and the upcoming PGC 2023 Pickem Challenge, this amount will see a surge. The final prize pool will be distributed based on the tournament's concluding rankings.

[b]Special Prize
[/b]The MVP of the tournament will be granted an extra prize of $10,000.


[h3]PGC 2023 Profit Shares
[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/e28e515c6519dea9dd1d34c081d4144d7b6253a4.png[/img]
All participating teams will benefit from 25% of PGC 2023 Skin sales, reflecting their end-tournament standings. More news on the upcoming PGC 2023 Pickem Challenge will be revealed later on. So, stay tuned and do not miss your chance to acquire unique PGC 2023 skins while supporting your favorite teams!


For the latest PUBG Esports updates, visit pubgesports.com and follow @pubgesports on social media.

newsitems.title: Patch Notes - Update 26.1
newsitems.author: [****] UZI
newsitems.contents:
[h2]26.1 Highlights
[/h2][previewyoutube=OWhGPPc0oJE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Live Maintenance Schedule
[/h2]※ The times shown below are subject to change.
PC: October 11, 12 AM - 8:30 AM (UTC)
Console: October 19, 1 AM - 10 AM (UTC)

[h2]Live Server Updates
[/h2][b]- Tactical Gear will not be released on the #26.1 Live Server. We've used the Test Server to analyze potential gameplay changes resulting from modifications to Tactical Gear's acquisition method and performance, and in conclusion, based on your invaluable feedback and our internal data analysis, we've decided to go back to carefully considering the future integration of this feature. We're committed to continuously seeking your insights for any gameplay-affecting updates through our Test Servers.[/b]
- Adjusted map probability for random map regions based on player feedback.
- (PC) Fixed the issue preventing the activation of the client's anti-aliasing graphic setting following a Death Cam view or during a replay pause.
- (PC) Fixed the issue causing the generation of two replays after viewing the Death Cam during spectation.

[h2]Map Service
[/h2]※ Please note that PC players can anticipate map changes every Wednesday at 2 AM UTC, while Console players can expect the same every Thursday at 7 AM UTC.
※ (October 25 update) In Random Map regions, larger maps have a 25% probability of being selected, while smaller maps have a 12.5% probability.

[b](PC) Test Server
[/b]- Normal Match: Erangel
ㅤㅤ- AS region: Squad - TPP
ㅤㅤ- NA region: Squad - FPP

[b]Live Server - Normal Match
[/b]- Week 1: Erangel / Miramar / Vikendi / Sanhok / Paramo
ㅤㅤ- PC: October 11 ~ October 18
ㅤㅤ- Console: October 19 ~ October 26
- Week 2: Erangel / Taego / Deston / Sanhok / Karakin
ㅤㅤ- PC: October 18 ~ October 25
ㅤㅤ- Console: October 26 ~ November 2
- Week 3: Erangel / Miramar / Vikendi / Sanhok / Paramo
ㅤㅤ- PC: October 25 ~ November 1
ㅤㅤ- Console: November 2 ~ November 9
- Week 4: Erangel / Taego / Deston / Sanhok / Karakin
ㅤㅤ- PC: November 1 ~ November 8
ㅤㅤ- Console: November 9 ~ November 16

[b]Live Server - Ranked
[/b]- Ranked: Erangel (30%) / Miramar (30%) / Taego (30%) / Vikendi (10%)
- The map service for Ranked is updated on a season-by-season basis.


[b]※ Please note that the features and updates described below are subject to change or removal due to issues such as bugs, in-game problems, and community feedback. The images used are intended as visual references only; the actual game may look different as the builds are continually developed and refined before release.
[/b]

[h2]Tactical Gear
[/h2][i]Dev's comment: Tactical Gear returns this update.

Following its temporary removal in Update 25.2, we embarked on an in-depth review of the acquisition methods and the overarching influence and balance of Tactical Gear. Foremost, we recognized that providing every player with Tactical Gear detracted from the foundational gameplay experience of players landing unarmed and scavenging for items - LAND, LOOT, SURVIVE.

And thus, after carefully considering your feedback and our internal metrics, we're reintroducing Tactical Gear (with the balanced version of specific gear that gave away excessive information during the match) as a world-spawn item starting with the 26.1 Test Server.

[b]The Test Server launches today. We encourage you to try out the updated Tactical Gear and share your thoughts.
[/b][/i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/7475fa13300b3cde1a6747a44e7f56973fd517af.jpg[/img]
[h3]General Changes
[/h3]- Tactical Gear will now world-spawn individually throughout the map.
- Acquired Tactical Gear is stored directly in your Inventory.
- Equipped Tactical Gear will occupy the sixth slot in the Inventory.
ㅤㅤ- There's a brief delay while equipping, which you can cancel.
- You can loot multiple Tactical Gear, but only one can be equipped.
- An equipped Tactical Gear cannot be dropped.
- If you re-enter the match after a Comeback BR or through the Recall system, your previous Tactical Gear is removed, allowing for a new one to be equipped.
- Tactical Gear can be stored in vehicle trunks and Tactical Packs.

[h3]Drone[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/c15f58d4f8732d28f6f9f09ca3dd589f4153aea1.jpg[/img]
- Max distance: 200m → 150m
- Increased acceleration noise volume.
- Added a smoke effect to destroyed Drones.
- An icon indicating the destroyed Drone's location has been added, visible on your screen when you have the Drone Tablet equipped.
- Drones cannot be deployed when you are in a prone position.

[h3]Spotter Scope
[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/7497092b809461f3a694835ea0b52062377b8f46.jpg[/img]
- Marker duration: 7 seconds → 5 seconds
- Marking enemies concealed by smoke is no longer possible.
ㅤㅤ- Pre-existing markers will remain visible even if the enemy move into smoke.
ㅤㅤ- This applies to both Smoke Grenades and the M79.

[h2]World[/h2]
[h3]Erangel
[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/aef76df46c86ad4bb367d9c256db075ae7179dd0.jpg[/img]
※ The following updates apply to every mode.
[b]Area Modifications
[/b]We have enhanced areas near the center of the Erangel map that are less frequently explored by players. Stalber and the submerged village have been visually refreshed, Mylta has been given a makeover that retains its essence while offering a fresh perspective, and Ruins and Georgopol have been optimized for smoother gameplay with improved loot distribution and navigation options.

[b]Stalber[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/f1f250d3aab3fef9d563c0da0304fba9cc1317bf.jpg[/img]
- Reorganized the area by adopting an astronomical observatory theme with a dome looking up at the sky.
- Revamped the entire layout, introducing new structures and looting spots.
- The surrounding landscape has been enhanced for better accessibility.

[b]Boatyard[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/2bc69e5a307306d0b489b72c78010cdf7c8ede97.jpg[/img]
- Reorganized the submerged village located between Rozhok and Ruins into a harbor themed area.
- Enhanced the entire layout, introducing new structures.
- Named it Boatyard on the Minimap.

[b]Ruins[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/8fde06769a0dc4298632097d6f54acfeaaf1bc97.jpg[/img]
- Revamped the entire layout to provide better accessibility when looting.
- Enhanced the surrounding landscape for better vehicle accessibility.
- Added a dirt road leading inside Ruins.
- Made some minor tweaks to the shape of the interior ruins.

[b]Mylta[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/58380c2b9e4c968cae6612413dab74f398dee233.jpg[/img]
- Blending old and new concepts, we reorganized the area into a town with a stream of water in the center and cornfields.
- Enhanced the general layout and looting efficiency.
- Added trees on the beach to provide more cover.

[b]Georgopol[/b]
- Modified the overall layout, relocating some buildings.
- Enhanced the surrounding landscape.
- Added cover such as abandoned cars and trees.

[i]Dev's comment: Erangel stands as the heart and soul of PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS - we believe it is a cherished map that stirs nostalgia for many of our players. Therefore, working on its update, given its iconic status, was definitely challenging. Yet, as PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS evolves, we recognized the importance of ushering Erangel into the same progressive journey.

In this update, our mission was to blend Erangel's intrinsic charm with enhancements that elevate the player experience without losing the map's foundational essence.

We began with the heart of the map, focusing on central areas which, in spite of their strategic locations, were often overlooked. After analyzing the pros and cons of these lesser-visited places, we've added some freshness into them - areas that were once generic have now been transformed with unique themes, designed to draw you in. We've also fine-tuned various elements based on player feedback to create even more dynamic combat scenarios.

We hope these refinements broaden the strategic scope, from early-game looting to crucial late-game tactics. We remain committed to enhancing Erangel, introducing new elements while amplifying the existing attributes that render Erangel truly iconic.
[/i]
 
[h3]Secret Room
[/h3]Accessible only through underground entrances in Erangel's natural surroundings, Erangel's Secret Rooms have been untouched for a long time. Only the sharpest players will have the opportunity to obtain rare items from Secret Rooms. Make sure to leave before enemies arrive since engagements here can be quite deadly!
- Secret Rooms containing high-value items have been added throughout Erangel.
- Secret Rooms can be accessed using the world-spawned Secret Room Keys.
- Available in Normal and Custom Matches.

[h3]Spawns[/h3]
- Added and adjusted a small number of vehicle spawn spots in Normal Match and Ranked.

[h3]Map[/h3]
- In alignment with the above changes, the World Map and Minimap have been updated.

[h3]Misc.
[/h3]- Refined the landscape and added some trees that can be used for cover.
- Adjusted the height of some containers.
- Optimized overall object textures.

[h3]World Misc.
[/h3]- Removed the Aston Martin containers from starting areas.

[h2]Collaboration: KFC
[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/4bfaf4059a1931d01b08fa2a6feb8c199ac6d93d.jpg[/img]
Finger Lickin' goodness meets PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS! KFC, renowned for serving the finest Chicken Dinners, has landed in Erangel. Explore KFC stores on the revamped Erangel map and keep an eye out for upcoming KFC events!
- Erangel's gas stations have transformed into KFC stores.
- You can obtain exclusive KFC Chicken Combos from kiosks nestled inside KFC stores. 
ㅤㅤ- Engage with the kiosk using the Interaction Key.
ㅤㅤ- After your order is placed, your nickname will appear on the order number display board as your KFC Chicken Combo spawns on the counter.
ㅤㅤ- Each player may use the kiosk once per KFC store and once more after entering Phase 4.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/d2da28a4d6b49480e61b5e365c9bc86e2e0091b8.jpg[/img]
- You can earn the following items with the KFC Chicken Combo:
ㅤㅤ- KFC Chicken Bucket
ㅤㅤㅤㅤ- Functions like the First Aid Kit and showcases your character savoring the chicken leg when consumed. 
ㅤㅤ- KFC Secret Recipe Fries
ㅤㅤㅤㅤ- Functions like the Bandage and showcases your character enjoying the fries when consumed. 
ㅤㅤ- KFC Drink
ㅤㅤㅤㅤ- Functions like the Energy Drink.
- The KFC stores in Erangel are available for one month.
- KFC billboards have been added to Erangel, Miramar, Sanhok, and Vikendi.
- KFC banners have been added to starting planes for Erangel, Miramar, Sanhok, Vikendi, Karakin, Taego, and Deston.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/102d415337f128392555b2f2b1762d5d30083ddd.jpg[/img]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[h3]Thermal 4x Scope
[/h3]- Will no longer world-spawn and instead spawn in certain areas such as in Care Packages, Secret Rooms, Lab Camps, and Supply Drops.

[i]Dev's comment: Since its introduction, the Thermal 4x Scope - capable of detecting enemies hidden in smoke, darkness, and foliage - has demonstrated impressive efficiency. We've noted a trend where this scope became increasingly pivotal, especially in end-game scenarios where smoke tactics become vital. Additionally, the Thermal 4x Scope played a significant role in many long-range engagements. Additionally, as this item is relatively discovered frequently as a world-spawn item, we believe this is likely to have influenced the situations mentioned above.

Therefore, coupled with consistent player feedback on its potency, we've decided to modify the item's spawn method - in order to preserve the distinct feature of the item that detects heat, we aim to decrease the appearance frequency of the Thermal 4x Scope, making it a more sought-after and rare item instead of modifying its performance.
[/i]
[h3]Killfeed[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/e8bb22616bff2325852c3dab7227dd6cf3efb56d.jpg[/img]
- Added team numbers to killfeeds and match logs in Normal Match and Ranked.
- Team numbers are also displayed in replay and observer/spectator modes, but not in streamer mode.
- Applies to Normal Match, Ranked, Intense Battle Royale, and Custom Match modes.
- Displayed regardless of whether the Clan name is present or not.
- Not displayed on the system message shown in the center of the screen.

[i]Dev Comment: As outlined in our Roadmap previously announced in March, we are dedicated to narrowing the gap between Esports, Ranked, and Normal Match. As a direct response to our goals and player suggestions, we are adding team numbers to both killfeeds and match logs through this update.

In the realm of Esports, keeping track of team numbers to strategize effectively demands a high degree of concentration and discernment. However, it is also one of the exhilarating aspects of PUBG. Even for players who may not yet feel entirely confident in combat, the inclusion of team numbers enables them to contribute to their team's success. With this update, our aim is to encourage more intricate and collaborative teamwork among players.
[/i]
[h2]Ranked - Season 26
[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/928793ac6ce70fd0abf47606732abd4ca4814516.jpg[/img]
- The leaderboard will reset after the Live Server maintenance.
- Check out your final Tier from the previous season through your Career page.

[h3]Season 25 Rewards
[/h3]Below are the rewards you'll be receiving based on your final Tier from the previous Ranked season.
[b]- Bronze - Bronze PUBG ID Emblem
- Silver - Silver PUBG ID Emblem
- Gold - Gold PUBG ID Emblem, Ranked Parachute Skin
- Platinum - Animated Platinum PUBG ID Emblem, Ranked Parachute Skin, Platinum Medal
- Diamond - Animated Diamond PUBG ID Emblem, Ranked Parachute Skin, Platinum, Diamond Medal
- Master - Animated Master PUBG ID Emblem, Animated Master Nameplate, Ranked Parachute Skin, Platinum, Diamond, Master Medal
- Top 500 - Bonus rewards for Top 500 players: Animated Top 500 PUBG ID Emblem, Animated Top 500 Nameplate[/b]
---
- The Parachute skin and Medals are permanent rewards.
- The rest of the obtainable rewards are available for use during a single Ranked season.
- Rewards can be found in your Inventory once Season 26 starts.
- Once Season 26 is over and the server undergoes maintenance, every reward but the Parachute and Medal will be withdrawn from your Edit Profile page.

[h2]Arcade[/h2]
- Along with the Erangel updates, we've added Ruins and removed Stalber for Team Deathmatch.

[h2]Custom Match
[/h2]Made changes to the Custom Match settings to align with Erangel's update.
- Team Deathmatch
ㅤㅤ- Added Ruins preset.
ㅤㅤ- Removed Stalber preset.
- War Mode: Conquest
ㅤㅤ- Updated Mylta.
ㅤㅤ- Removed Stalber.
- Zombie Mode - Erangel
ㅤㅤ- Adjusted player starting positions.

[h2]Match Report
[/h2]Refined the Match Report to enhance its usability. 
- Overview and Weapons pages have been reorganized, and Stats page has been added.
- Applies to Normal Match and Ranked.
- Ranked results (rank/RP and change) and playtime are now displayed at the top of the Match Report.

[h3]Overview Page
[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/25c541e84c13688df03afec8c6abf292d9e66360.jpg[/img]
[b]Added[/b]
- Number of assists
- Number of times you revived a teammate
- My Weapon Stats
ㅤㅤ- Percentage of hits per body area
ㅤㅤ- Kills, Headshot Kills, Knockdowns Achieved, and Longest Kills

[b]Changed[/b]
- Survival time no longer includes spectating time.

[b]Removed[/b]
- Phases Survived
- Survival BP Earned
- Medals
- Account status (Plus)
- Best Weapon (Primary Weapon)
- Survival Mastery Tier
- Survival Mastery Level
- Total Survival Mastery XP Earned
- Detail XP
ㅤㅤ- Bonus XP (Plus)
ㅤㅤ- Combat, Survival, Earned, Used

[h3]Weapons Page
[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/8046fa6b51818085727584390c7ddf5b2ec8d38e.jpg[/img]
[b]Added[/b]
- Additional information for each weapon
ㅤㅤ- Kills, Headshot Kills, Knockdowns Achieved, Longest Kills
ㅤㅤ- Percentage of hits per body area
ㅤㅤ- Damage dealt per body area

[b]Removed[/b]
- Weapon Mastery Level
- Earned Weapon Mastery XP
- Base XP
- Time Bonus %

[h3]Stats Page
[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/221fc0d19741343a0fb65d55b5d53f211fb8b38e.jpg[/img]
[b]Added[/b]
- Additional Match Information
ㅤㅤ- Knockdowns Achieved
ㅤㅤ- Knockdowns Suffered
ㅤㅤ- Number of heals / amount recovered 
ㅤㅤ- Number of boosts / amount recovered
ㅤㅤ- Weapons Acquired
ㅤㅤ- Road Kills
ㅤㅤ- Vehicles Destroyed
ㅤㅤ- Redeployments
ㅤㅤㅤㅤ- Number of successful redeployments
ㅤㅤㅤㅤ- Comeback BR redeployments
ㅤㅤㅤㅤ- Blue Chip Revive redeployments
ㅤㅤ- Number of times revived by teammates
ㅤㅤ- Number of Self-AED revives

[i]Dev Comment: Through Update 26.1, we aim to address known issues of the Match Report, which should serve as a tool to illustrate the course of a match and incorporate content that players wish to see. In doing so, we have eliminated repetitive information from Match Report, which will still be accessible on the End of Match screen.

Our goal with these changes is to provide players with clearer insights into their shooting performance, allowing them to reflect on their gunplay. By adding stats of revives and assists to the Match Report, we also aim to offer players a quick overview of their contributions to the team. We hope this will promote teamwork and enable players to conduct more thorough assessments of their own gameplay for improvement.
[/i]
[h2]Bug Fixes
[/h2][b]Gameplay[/b]
- Fixed an issue where Drones are deployed below the landscape on inclined terrains.
- Fixed the issue of throwables not being able to pass through Aston Martin "DBX707" SUV windows.
- Fixed the issue to prevent the simultaneous use of healing/boost items and primary gunplay actions when using the Interaction key.
- Fixed the narrowing ignition range issue when a Smoke Grenade is affixed to a tree.
- (PC) Fixed the issue where, during Replays, characters appear stationary during their initial descent.
- (PC) Fixed the issue where, in both Death Cams and Replays, if a character's vehicle dismount has been captured, the character appears stationary upon dismounting.
- (PC) Fixed the issue where you experience abnormal zooming speeds (using the mouse wheel) when simultaneously using a 6x or higher Scope with a Canted Sight.

[b]World[/b]
- Fixed collision, texture, performance, and some other general Taego and Karakin issues.

[b]UX/UI
[/b]- Fixed the text's and icon's misalignment issue when viewing the Prime Parcel without owning it.
- Fixed a display issue in the lobby with the custom lobby skin - Showroom equipped.
- Fixed the text color inconsistency in the Bunny Patrol - Contraband Crate when obtaining the Chroma; the "Ultimate" text was erroneously shown in red (Legendary).
- Fixed the issue where the killfeed icon stretched horizontally after a player was knocked out or killed by a Mortar.
- (PC) Corrected a typo in the "Player's movement seemed unusually fast" phrase for the Portuguese (Brazil) language in the Report Player option.
- (PC) Fixed the issue so the mission list now displays correctly after rejoining a match.
- (PC) Fixed the intermittent issues with the End of Match screen not appearing post-match.
- (Console) Fixed the issue where the pointer would disappear after scrolling and selecting and closing a filter when attempting to Disassemble/Repurpose in the Workshop.
- (Console) Fixed the issue where you were unable to join a team when your Team Invite option is set to "Block All".
- (Console) Fixed the freezing issue when selecting a random Wheels skin for the Aston Martin vehicle on the PlayStation® platform.

[b]Items & Skins
[/b]- Fixed the issue where an earring is visible on the screen when in ADS with the Hairstyle 45 equipped.
- Fixed the issue where parts of the legs turn transparent when a female character equips the B.A.S.A. Bunny Outfit/Moon Rabbit Outfit with certain shoes.
- (PC) Fixed the inconsistent appearance in how the Moon Lizard's Gloves appeared when equipped.

newsitems.title: Arcade: Halloween Battle Royale
newsitems.author: [****] UZI
newsitems.contents:
Hello players!

As the brisk breezes of late September herald a ghostly resurgence, Halloween Battle Royale returns to set the stage for some spooky festivities! Ready yourselves to choose from four spine-chilling classes, showcase frightful teamwork, and proclaim your eerie triumph beneath the glow of the crimson moon.

If your memories of the mode's rules have faded into the mists of time, fear not - we've prepared a guide below for all souls brave enough to join the fray.

[h2]Basic Rules[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/5becc3ca8cad21b28caf1961c5e8404e8220a543.jpg[/img]

Players will be asked to transform into their preferable class, board the Ghost Ship, jump down into dark Erangel and fight to be the last standing.

[list]    [*]Halloween Battle Royale mode is available to play at the Arcade.[/*]    [*]Once matchmaking is done, a window will pop up where players can choose to be either an Executioner, Ranger, Pyromancer, or Cleric.[list]            [*]Players will have time to choose their class in the pre-game lobby; they can also bring the class window back up by pressing F8 for PC or X for Console.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]The first circle will be shown on the map once players hop on the Ghost Ship.[list]            [*]At the same time, players will be equipped with their respective class's Level 1 weapon, ring, and necklace.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Players will have to loot ingredients to upgrade their weapons.[/*]    [*]Fight foes with your class skills, show great teamwork with your squad, and win Halloween Battle Royale.[/*][/list]
[h2]Halloween Battle Royale Classes[/h2]
Now's the time to introduce the four different classes: Executioner, Ranger, Pyromancer, or Cleric. Since there are no limits to the number of a certain class in a single squad, teammates should get tactical and put their heads together to think about what combination they could come up with.

However, keep in mind that each class requires its own exclusive ingredients to grow stronger! Therefore, it would be efficient to share loot among different classes, but it's obviously not the best to share the loot you would need if your squad is made up of four Executioners.

Another important note: once players upgrade their Level 1 weapons to Level 2, they can choose between two different types of weapons. Each weapon has different skills so make sure to craft and wield wisely! But do not fear; players can switch between the two weapons in every upgrade stage.

[h2]Executioner[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/10e4ba2c28f0ae866187ad069d6e1dbed00d7483.jpg[/img]
[b][i]"I'm here for the SLAUGHTERFEST!"[/i][/b]

An Executioner is your classic melee warrior that can chase down or pull enemies in for brutal combat.
[list]    [*]Default Weapon: Axe of Swiftness[list]            [*]Executioners can dash towards enemies.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Alternate Weapon (Craftable from Level 2): Halberd of Restraint[list]            [*]Executioners can pull in enemies within a certain area.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]Executioners also generate class-exclusive items throughout the game.
[list]    [*]Stun Ball: Stuns enemies for 2 seconds.[/*]    [*]Liquid Courage: Enhances moving speed and boosts HP for a certain amount of time.[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/a9dd1468766c410997b0416af8bac758a35a9909.jpg[/img]
[h2]Ranger[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/65720924a7b5aaa70f257864f04476d150983adc.jpg[/img]
[i][b]"Always stay alert. I might come for you from atop the trees, the thickest undergrowth, or from right behind you."[/b][/i]

A Ranger can either become a sniper who deals damage from afar or a stealthy assassin that dives in for a sneak attack.
[list][*]Default Weapon: Fatal Crossbow
[list][*]Powerful long-range weapon.[/list][*]Alternate Weapon (Craftable from Level 2): Blade of Invisibility[list][*]Short-ranged melee weapon that allows Rangers to turn invisible for a certain amount of time.[*]Attacking enemies from behind or during an invisible state will apply more damage.[/list][/list]Rangers also generate class-exclusive items throughout the game.[list][*] Snare Trap: Rangers can set up traps and root enemies for 5 seconds.[*] Stun Grenade: The same old stun grenade.[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/04bfb34b5cdf625b1b21ad8f16fecfb71fd63c2d.jpg[/img]
[h2]Pyromancer[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/57cb4d2f3b0e619b1f311b4eda83ba015b0453db.jpg[/img]
[i][b]"Aah... the smell of burning flesh."[/b][/i]

A Pyromancer specializes in assaulting multiple enemies at once with deadly fire.
[list][*]Default Weapon: Gloves of Calamity
[list][*]Allows Pyromancers to attack with Fireballs.
[*]Deals great damage but is difficult to wield.[/list][*]Alternate Weapon (Craftable from Level 2): Hellfire Cannon[list][*]Can fire infinitely.[*]May overheat and be unusable for a certain amount of time if continuously used.[/list][/list]Pyromancers also cast spells throughout the game.[list][*] Firewall: Generates large firewalls to block the enemy's path.
[*] Meteor Shower: Generates powerful meteors. This can only be activated when the Pyromancer's necklace is Level 3 or above.[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/1b87151eda153349efef29fc9f8c71963bf16461.jpg[/img]
[h2]Cleric[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/e2ae1d5d2e804ad61ea29bf87e18e96ed4d72f9c.jpg[/img]
[i][b]"I'm not a nice doctor; BLEED to HEAL!"[/b][/i]

A Cleric is an aggressive healer that can lock in melee combat.

[list][*]Default Weapon: Mace of Suffering and Aegis of Light
[list][*]The Mace of Suffering is a melee weapon that causes enemies to bleed for a certain amount of time.
[*]Using the Mace of Suffering on teammates will restore their HP.
[*]The Aegis of Light blocks crossbow attacks.[/list]
[*]Alternate Weapon (Craftable from Level 2): Triage Shotgun
[list][*]Shooting teammates will restore their HP.
[*]Shooting enemies will debuff them and cause slight damage.[/list][/list]
Clerics also generate class-exclusive items throughout the game.
[list][*]Vitality Bomb: Restores HP.
[*]First Aid Kit: Healing item that can be shared with teammates.[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/54232b106dee080e761dcb0dfa4f8067ffd4c2cf.jpg[/img]
[h2]Items and Crafting[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/039121f028760692eb85a076ebfcddb8743df299.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Halloween Battle Royale has its own set of items spawned throughout the map, so players won't be finding any weapons, ammo, throwables, boosts, or equipment.
[list][*]However, bandages will spawn.
[*]The items that players will find will mostly be ingredients to upgrade weapons, rings, and necklaces.[/list][*]Each class-specific weapon, ring, and necklace given to the players at the beginning cannot be dropped or traded.[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/98931ee1197c8defa42a1ba2e6af0a02f768b4ab.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Players can open the crafting window by pressing Tab.
[*]The looted ingredients are used to upgrade players' weapons, ring, and necklace.
[*]Players can right-click to upgrade craftable items (which will glow up).
[*]Since each class has two weapons, players will be shown two weapon-crafting routes.
[list][*]Each class's Level 1 weapon is set as default but starting from Level 2, players can choose to craft to either of the two weapons (Ex. Players can craft a Executioner's Level 1 Axe to Level 2 Axe OR Level 2 Halberd).[/list][/list]
[h2]Treasure Chests (Care Packages)[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/9755fe9726d1fc04d606f06437be1279bc0680d6.jpg[/img]
Treasure falling from the sky! The care packages will be looking like Treasure Chests in Halloween Battle Royale.
[list][*] Treasure Chests contain general and Level 5 crafting ingredients.
[*] Dropped Treasure Chests will be marked on the map.
[*] Players will have to damage the Treasure Chest to open it.
[*] The squad that successfully opens and interacts with the Treasure Chest is given an invincibility buff for 10 seconds.[/list]
[h2]Vehicles[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/88b5bd6c35a637625627fdb95bead8d2596bf3c0.jpg[/img][list][*]Instead of normal vehicles and planes, Halloween Battle Royale will only have the "Night Slayer" UAZ and Ghost Ships.
[*]Vehicles' speed and HP were nerfed in this mode to prompt more dynamic gameplay.[/list]
[h2]Service Schedule[/h2]

Halloween Battle Royale will be available at the Arcade during the following period.

[b]PC & Console[/b][list][*] PC & Console: September 27, 7 AM ~ October 10, 7 AM UTC[/list][h2]Gameplay Settings[/h2]
[list][*] Map: Erangel
[*] TPP Only
[*] 20 Squads of 4 (Max. 80 players per match)
[*] Halloween Battle Royale only supports 4-Man Squads
[list][*] It will automatically find teammates for you if you're not a full squad[/list][/list][h2]Arcade Gameplay[/h2]
[list][*] Does not provide XP or gameplay rewards.
[*]Will not be reflected on the Career page.
[*]Will not be reflected in your Match History.
[*]Does not support replays.[/list]

See you on the Battlegrounds.

newsitems.title: NAVI PGC 2022 Champion Edition Skins - Available NOW!
newsitems.author: [****] UZI
newsitems.contents:
[previewyoutube=YeyuRvFJ4QQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello, PUBG Esports fans!

As we gear up for the upcoming PGC 2023, we're thrilled to unveil the PGC 2022 Champion Edition Skins. Unlike previous offerings, these sets are enriched with gear skins, meticulously designed by the reigning champions themselves, Natus Vincere.

Dive into the game with a skin that not only enhances your visuals but also resonates with the heartbeat of champion-level gameplay!

newsitems.title: Dev Letter: Anti-Cheat 2023 1H Review
newsitems.author: [****] UZI
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/e5047db847bac91c33655eff4910c688a5ae161a.jpg[/img]

Hello players. 

As we near the latter half of 2023, we've seen some significant changes within PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS since the unveiling of our [url=https://pubg.com/en/news/4942]2023 Roadmap[/url]. Among the various topics that have garnered your inquiries, there's one that particularly stands out: What steps are we taking to address cheating? 

In today's Anti-Cheat Dev Letter, we embark on a retrospective journey through the first half of 2023 and offer a glimpse into our future plans. We'll delve into the Anti-Cheat initiatives undertaken since our previous [url=https://pubg.com/en/news/1612]Anti-Cheat Dev Letter in December 2021[/url] and give you a sneak peek at our plans for the remainder of 2023.

[h2][b]2021 ~ 2023 Understanding Metrics and Current Status[/b][/h2]

Our Anti-Cheat Team analyzes various internal metrics to track the state of illegal software. Today, we'll focus on the most important one, the "Percentage of Suspected Cheaters," to explain the current state of Anti-Cheat. 

As outlined in our [url=https://pubg.com/en/news/1612]December 2021 Dev Letter[/url], we've reduced the percentage of suspected cheaters by around 47% since the second half of 2021. This was achieved by deploying our proprietary Anti-Cheat system, Zakynthos, and making enhancements to our hardware ban system. 

However, from October 2022, the situation deteriorated as it showed a resurgence in the percentage of suspected cheaters due to several challenges, including an uptick in the circumvention of hardware bans. In response, we have embarked on two missions: to fortify our countermeasures and to prevent cheaters from re-entering the game. As a result, since June 2023, we have observed metrics aligning with or surpassing previous benchmarks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/96e6d420a61f21292b03971c714cca6a7c4f5b69.jpg[/img]

While the current percentage of suspected cheaters represents an improvement relative to the past, our work is far from complete. Our commitment is to ensure that the impact of our Anti-Cheat measures is palpable to our players, and we pledge to share our progress in a detailed and transparent manner. 

Today, we'd like to share some of the vital Anti-Cheat activities undertaken in the first half of 2023 and outline the additional work planned for the latter half of the year to ensure a fair gaming environment.

[h2][b]Anti-Cheat Activities in '23. 1H[/b][/h2]

First, we will share the major Anti-Cheat activities carried out in the first half of 2023.

[h3][b]Enhancing Countermeasures against Cheating[/b][/h3]

To improve player experience concerning illegal software, we primarily focused on bolstering our cheater detection capabilities. We've directed considerable efforts toward refining our proprietary Anti-Cheat solution, Zakynthos, with the incorporation of new features aimed at swifter and more accurate cheater detection. Consequently, in the first half of this year, we successfully pinpointed and banned approximately 1.7 million accounts—a 39% increase compared to last year's timeframe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/0ebd352f5831f30fbf6a456c44224cc47478083b.jpg[/img]

Furthermore, we've fortified the security of our game client. We identified vulnerabilities within our existing game engine that made it easier for illegal software developers to access and analyze our data. In April and July, we implemented enhancements to cover these vulnerabilities, and we remain committed to further raising the bar for illegal software development.

[h3][b]Preventing the Re-Entry of Cheaters[/b][/h3]

We've also made several enhancements to address hardware ban circumvention, which began to increase in the latter half of 2022. As a result, hardware bans increased by approximately 28% compared to the first half of 2022. We believe that these enhancements, combined with the improvements to our detection capabilities mentioned earlier, have worked together to deter cheaters from re-entering the game, reducing the percentage of suspected cheaters. 

Furthermore, as previously mentioned in our [url=https://pubg.com/en/news/6471]Dev Letter: Tackling the Supply of Accounts Used for Cheating[/url], we've observed some positive changes, including a reduced supply of accounts used for cheating. This positive shift has been achieved through our strengthened response to Survival Mastery Level abuse. While we continue to bolster our actions against Survival Mastery Level abuse, we also plan on utilizing our hijacked account detection model to address accounts used by cheaters in Ranked.

[h2][b]Plans for '23. 2H[/b][/h2]

While we have made notable strides in reducing the number of suspected cheaters compared to prior years, we acknowledge that there is always room for improvement. We understand that some players still may not feel a significant decrease in cheaters. To combat this, our Anti-Cheat Team will continue to implement the measures taken in the first half of the year to reinforce our response further and deter the re-entry of cheaters. Moreover, we remain steadfast in our commitment to address additional challenges, which we will outline below.

[h3][b]Enhancing Detection Capabilities and Preventing the Re-Entry[/b][/h3]

We will continue enhancing Zakynthos to expedite the detection of illegal software usage. Two key additions are currently in the works to strengthen its detection capabilities. 

In addition, we are dedicated to training and enhancing the Survival Mastery Level abuse detection model, which we introduced in our previous Dev Letter. We also plan to develop a model for determining whether an account has been hijacked. We have already completed the initial development of a highly accurate account hijacking detection model and intend to refine its precision to apply it to various Anti-Cheat measures.

[h3][b]Continuing to Improve False Ban Issues[/b][/h3]

We are aware of the fact that many players have consistently shared their feedback regarding the issue of innocent players facing temporary bans during investigations. 

While we've been working on refining the various ban-triggering conditions, we acknowledge that we have yet to reach the level of detail you've asked for. Therefore, we've gone beyond simply tweaking these conditions and implemented comprehensive improvements to enhance ban accuracy. These improvements focus on reducing the chances of innocent players being erroneously banned by refining the characteristics that distinguish cheaters from legitimate players. We've initiated these improvements since August and will continue refining them.

[h3][b]Reinforcing the Authentication Process for Ranked[/b][/h3]

Besides the mentioned Anti-Cheat measures, we are also exploring systemic approaches to deter cheaters from re-entering the game. For instance, we are working on enhancing mobile authentication for Ranked and plan to implement it in November. We will share more information on this in upcoming Dev Letters. 

By expanding our monitoring scope, we are also gearing up for a more robust response to the issue of players with abnormal records listed at the top of Ranked leaderboards. Moreover, we will persist in efforts to thwart the incorporation of illegal software features that exploit vulnerabilities in game design.

[h2][b]Concluding Today's Anti-Cheat Dev Letter[/b][/h2]

Although we have outlined several Anti-Cheat initiatives In today's Dev Letter, we acknowledge that further efforts are necessary to ensure a fair gaming environment. Our Anti-Cheat Team will remain steadfast in fighting against illegal software, and we promise to do our best to make players feel the impact of our actions. We pledge to keep you informed about our Anti-Cheat updates and genuinely value your feedback. 

We kindly request your continued support and trust, and we look forward to sharing more in the next Dev Letter.


Thank you.

[b]PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Anti-Cheat Team[/b]

[*] Click the "Claim Now" button below the claimable reward.
[*] Sign in to or sign up for an Amazon Prime account.
[list][*] You need an Amazon account to sign up for Prime. If you don't have an Amazon account, you can create one by clicking "Create Your Amazon Account."
[*] After signing up for Amazon Prime, you will be required to add a payment method. You can start your 7-day free trial first and pay the monthly payment after the trial.[/list][*] After you successfully set up your Amazon Prime account, you will be redirected to the reward claiming window.
[*] Press "Go to KRAFTON" to link your KRAFTON ID to your Amazon Prime account.
[*] You are required to agree to allow Prime Gaming the rights to access your game account information. After confirmation, you will be redirected to our Prime Gaming page.
[*] Click "Complete Claim" to receive your reward!

[*] Can I cancel my Prime membership?[list]
[*] Yes, you can cancel your membership anytime. To cancel, go to your Account & Settings page on primevideo.com and click "End Membership."[/list]

[*] Amazon Prime will initially extract $1.00 USD from your bank account to confirm your payment method. The $1.00 USD will be returned a few days later.[/list]
[*] Will every game platform linked to my KRAFTON ID receive the rewards?[list]
[*] Yes, every game platform tied to your KRAFTON ID will automatically receive the claimed rewards![/list]

newsitems.title: PUBG Care Package - Additional Q&A
newsitems.author: [****] UZI
newsitems.contents:
[previewyoutube=fHi1dm3DQ-4;full][/previewyoutube]
Hello players. 

On August 25th, we presented the first episode of PUBG Care Package - a live developer talk - for the South Korean region. During the live stream, our In-game Unit Director, Tae-hyun Kim, joined us for a heart-to-heart conversation to address a number of topics that players have been asking about. Before we delve into the details, we'd like to explain why this live stream was directed to a specific region.

Since PUBG is offered to an international audience, our content is usually curated for a global audience. However, when it comes to real-time, two-way interactive content, language barriers present a challenge to covering all regions simultaneously. As we explored more effective means of genuine communication, it dawned on us that the foremost priority is to talk with our players in a timely manner. Hence, we had to start with what we could do at the moment.

Consequently, we piloted the first episode of PUBG Care Package in South Korea, and now we're aiming to gradually extend our live developer talks by encompassing the right cast and methods for different regions. 

We'd like to reach out to players in other parts of the world by offering subsequent content based on our discussions that took place during the live stream. We hope you'll see this as the first step in our efforts to genuinely communicate with you, and we ardently anticipate your ongoing engagement with future episodes of PUBG Care Package.

The three main topics covered in this first episode of PUBG Care Package are: 1. Tactical Gear Carrier, 2. Dragunov, and 3. AUG. The major changes including these main topics that will be implemented in Update 25.2 are as below. For detailed information, please refer to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/578080/view/3677806476751507188?l=english]Patch Notes - Update 25.2[/url] and the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/578080/view/3666546844640745200?l=english]Dragunov and Aug Follow-up[/url] announcement.

- Temporary deactivation of Tactical Gear and Tactical Gear Carrier
- Changes to Dragunov - removal of probabilistic damage system and more
- AUG adjustments
- Fixing issues for the Aston Martin Special Vehicle Skins

In addition to the main topics listed above, we're sharing the questions and answers that were covered in the live stream in this announcement.

---

[b]Q. Are there plans to either rebalance or entirely remove Tactical Gear?

[/b]A. We initially designed Tactical Gear with the hope that players could experience team play in a richer and more varied manner. Particularly, we aimed for newcomers to the battlegrounds to feel encouraged, enabling them to contribute effectively to their teams and enjoy the gameplay experience even more.

Given this feedback, we've decided to temporarily deactivate Tactical Gear for Update 25.2, with plans for a potential reintroduction in a future patch.

During the Tactical Gear's deactivation period, we'll be re-evaluating the role and functionality of Tactical Gear from the ground up. We aim to integrate your feedback so it complements the game's core mechanics while enhancing your overall gameplay experience.


[b]Q: Since the AUG received some readjustments, is there a possibility that the M416 will receive an upgrade?

[/b]A. At the moment, we have no plans to improve other ARs. This decision aims to maintain the time-to-kill (TTK) within a certain range, ensuring the fundamental gameplay of PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS remains consistent and doesn't become overly challenging for new players.


[b]Q. Players continue to have unpleasant experiences with cheaters. Is there anything you can share about PUBG's anti-cheat measures?

[/b]A. We are aware that many players are experiencing inconveniences due to illegal software and cheaters. We would like to assure you that our Anti-Cheat Team are diligently working to address these concerns.

While we continue to impose penalties on cheaters, we acknowledge that the effectiveness of such measures might not be immediately evident to players who have already endured undesirable encounters. Recognizing this, we acknowledge the necessity for preemptive measures to forestall the usage of illegal software and are working hard to improve our measures.

However, the situation resembles an unceasing battle, where the developers of illegal software often outpace our efforts to counter them. Players have also inquired about hardware bans; hardware bans have been implemented indeed, but we have observed instances where cheaters manage to circumvent them. Our Anti-Cheat Team is tenaciously working to block these circumvention tactics, marking a continuous battle.

There is even a rumor that we collaborate with developers of illegal software, which is absolutely not true. As individuals committed to the long-term success of PUBG, we know better than anyone the detrimental impact illegal software has on our game. We want to assure you that none of these rumors should be given credence.

We are acutely aware that you seek stronger protection against illegal software and still suffer from unpleasant encounters with cheaters. We would like to guarantee you that we are working hard to improve this, and we are devoted to enhancing your overall gaming experience to the greatest extent possible.


[b]Q. Many players have expressed concerns about unjust temporary bans issued by the Anti-Cheat team. Are there any plans to enhance this process?

[/b]A. We are actively engaging in discussions with the Anti-Cheat team to explore avenues for refining the temporary ban procedures. While specific details are not available at this moment, our aim is to optimize the temporary ban process to minimize the likelihood of legitimate players being wrongfully banned.


[b]Q. There have been instances where players unexpectedly die while attempting to equip Special Vehicle Skins. Is the PUBG Team aware of this issue?

[/b]A. We are aware of several bugs that occur when attempting to equip Special Vehicle Skins and are actively working to fix them.


[b]Q. Are you aware of the following Zipline-related issues: occasionally being unable to aim over the shoulder while using the Zipline and experiencing instant death when colliding with Drones?

[/b]A. We were aware of these issues during the developmental phase, but to be honest we initially perceived these issues as rare occurrences, assuming they wouldn't happen frequently. However, we've observed a significant number of players encountering these issues. It is one of our top priorities to resolve them.


[b]Q. Could you shed light on the reason behind introducing the Sandstorm and Blizzard Zone?

[/b]A. While we understand that these features can spark debate, at the end of the day, winning or losing in PUBG is all about the decisions players make in various scenarios. The PUBG Team aspired to craft a dynamic world replete with diverse environments and variables, fostering the emergence of various strategies across different situations. We didn't introduce them to make the game more frustrating - we don't plan to remove the Sandstorm and Blizzard Zone, but we are considering to adjust the frequency of their occurrence, particularly in the later stages of the game.


[b]Q. Players have requested adjustments of Shotguns, what are your thoughts on this?

[/b]A. Shotguns are frequently used in the early stages and, surprisingly, in the later stages as well. Shotguns are intentionally designed to be powerful at close range combat. However, we've noticed that beyond a certain distance their damage seems to be higher than intended, so we are investigating whether this is a bug. We are also looking at adjusting the damage of Shotguns over distance.


[b]Q. While we appreciate the innovative concept behind the Thermal 4x Scope, I believe it rivals the power and efficiency of Spotter Scopes. Are there any plans to refine its functionality?

[/b]A. The Thermal 4x Scope, designed to detect heat, strikes a balance between gameplay and realism. We're aware of its pronounced impact on gameplay, but rather than eliminating it, we're exploring a range of enhancements, from adjusting the spawn rate to revisiting its spawn methods and other potential modifications.


[b]Q. What's your thought on the balance of SMGs?

[/b]A. The dev team views the SMG as a weapon that might not be exceptionally dominant or intuitive to use. Nonetheless, it's undoubtedly suited for close-quarters combat. Instead of simply tweaking balance, we aim to accentuate the distinct characteristics and advantages of SMGs.


[b]Q. The Ranked rewards, with a few exceptions, are reclaimed at a season's end. Are there any plans to improve this system?

[/b]A. Back in March, during our 6th anniversary roadmap announcement we committed to refining Ranked rewards this year. We're currently exploring various approaches, but while our preliminary decision is to enhance the rewards, we want to ensure that the enhancements resonate with our players. We apologize for the delay, and aim to share positive updates before the latter half of the upcoming year.


[b]Q. There is usually a notable skill gap among players during Ranked matchmaking. Are there initiatives in place to improve this?

[/b]A. The intricacies of matchmaking are undeniable. Balancing a diverse set of maps with the need to incorporate a vast number of players, all while differentiating by MMR is indeed a challenge. A broad matching pool is essential to achieve this seamlessly, but it's not always feasible.

For Ranked, the expectation is clear: players should be matched with others of similar skill. We're aware that the reality sometimes falls short of this ideal. And while we're earnestly exploring solutions, a definitive solution remains a work in progress.

That said, we believe that minimizing wait times is very important. While it's vital to strive for balanced matches, ensuring players can actually play a match without excessive waiting time comes first. We hope that players understand this decision, even if it may lead to less optimal matchups. But of course, our dedication to refining the system is ongoing, and we are actively seeking enhancements.


[b]Q. Each region seems to have distinct map preferences; is there a dedicated protocol for map rotations based on these preferences?

[/b]A. Indeed, in PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS, the vast array of maps coupled with the potential for up to 100 players in a single match demands a meticulous approach to the matchmaking environment.

Due to the number of various maps, the matchmaking pool is segmented. While some regions that have a robust matchmaking pool might not face challenges, others with a limited pool can experience inefficiencies when all maps are to be available. Consequently, we've implemented a system that circulates five maps during a certain period.

Recognizing our global audience, we acknowledge the varying map preferences across regions. We're actively deliberating on regional parameter solutions, such as having preferred maps fixed for specific regions, etc.


[b]Q. Are there plans to introduce Clan tournaments?

[/b]A. Undoubtedly appealing, but due to our distinctive Battle Royale genre, especially with our unique rules and participant dynamics, it requires careful consideration when conceptualizing a PUBG-specific tournament.


[b]Q. We're interested in the status of the transition to a new game engine. Any updates?

[/b]A. We're diligently working towards this transition, but it's premature to divulge specific advancements right now. What I can currently share is that our steadfast commitment to the new engine has led us to reinforce our team and resources.


[b]Q. Are there plans to add new creatures tailored to the unique feel of each map, like the bears in Vikendi?

[/b]A. From my perspective as the in-game unit director, I'm genuinely interested in such additions. Yet, while incorporating diverse elements can enrich the gameplay experience, there are certain aspects we must approach cautiously - the game environment has its distinct role and identity. It's difficult to confirm such additions at this moment, but we are giving it careful consideration. Feedback and ideas from our player community will always be valued and taken into account.


[b]Q. After the first recent live stream, are there plans for subsequent sessions like EP.2?

[/b]A. Definitely, given our recent broadcast was titled EP.1, it indicates our intention to continue with sessions such as EP.2, EP.3, and so forth.


[b]Q. How often do you envision hosting PUBG Care Package streams?

[/b]A. Our aspiration is to host discussions about in-game topics at least once every quarter. Moreover, we're open to organizing additional sessions when specific situations warrant it. While the regularity of these discussions is important, I believe the chosen topics hold even greater significance. We will ensure we prepare even more diverse topics and initiate these sessions in a timely manner.

---

Today, we explored key topics from our first PUBG Care Package session.

The launch of PUBG Care Package represents a new shift in our communication strategy - we were immensely grateful for the chance to genuinely connect with our players, and we deeply value the support you extended during our live stream.

Our commitments made during the stream aren't merely verbal assurances; we promise to translate our words into tangible actions.

And moreover, we are in active discussions to expand PUBG Care Package to encompass not just a segment but our entire global player base.

Until then, see you on the Battlegrounds.

The images used are intended as visual references only; the actual game may look different as the builds are continually developed and refined before release.
[/b]

[h2]Gunplay[/h2]
[h3]Dragunov[/h3]
Dragunov is now available in the game. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/2489b27d74b8bc1529d20882f4946de34def6478.jpg[/img]
- Weapon type: Designated Marksman Rifles (DMR)
- Ammo: 7.62mm
- Fire Mode: Single
- Damage: 60
- Effective range: 500m
- Muzzle velocity: 830m/s
- Rate of fire: 150 RPM
- Muzzle attachment: Every AR, DMR muzzle attachment.
- Magazine attachment: Every AR, DMR magazine attachment.
- Stock attachment: Cheekpad
- Can attach up to the 15x Scope.
- World-spawns.
- Dragunov is available in Normal Matches, Ranked, Training Grounds, and Custom Matches. 
ㅤ- In the case of Arcade, Dragunov can be used in Team Deathmatch and Intense Battle Royale, but not in Bluebomb Rush mode.

[b]Adjustments:
[/b]- Adjusted damage: 58 (Basic), 73 (Max) → 60 (Fixed)
ㅤ- Removed probabilistic damage system.

[i]Dev's comment: We've been listening to your invaluable feedback regarding the introduction of Dragunov, a weapon that was initially set to debut with a unique probabilistic damage system. Your participation in our recent survey allowed us to grasp your concerns regarding the probabilistic damage system and the fact that it might conflict with traditional skill-based gunplay. Our initial goal with Dragunov was to create a different gameplay experience and to add new excitement and unique elements to the usual game flow. But as we listened to your voices, we realized that this change might disrupt the core gameplay.

So in response to your input, we've made some critical changes. We've removed the probabilistic damage system, giving Dragunov a higher headshot damage compared to other DMRs. However, it still has a slower fire rate and higher recoil than other weapons in its category, giving it a more high-risk, high-reward feel. We also took into account your concerns shared in the survey and created limitations through damage thresholds ensuring that the new weapon doesn't overperform SRs in that area.

We will continue to monitor community feedback and metrics after Dragunov's release. We intend to maintain consistent communication with our players and strive to craft a well-balanced gunplay environment.
[/i]
[h3]AUG Adjustments
[/h3]- Rate of fire: 750 → 720 
- Adjusted horizontal and vertical recoil.

[i]Dev's comment: In March, we made changes to the existing meta, aiming to make the 5.56mm weaponss more appealing choices, and rebalanced the AUG, converting it to a world-spawn weapon. However, despite no separate balancing, its recent usage and win rates have risen rapidly, leading us to believe that performance adjustments are necessary. The fire rate of the AUG will be reduced, decreasing its DPS to a level that falls between the Beryl M762 and M416. Additionally, since a decrease in fire rate tends to lower perceived recoil, we've slightly increased the recoil  so that the perceived level is going to stay approximately the same. We anticipate that AUG's usage difficulty will remain similar and it will continue to be a competitive weapon even after this change. 
[/i]
[h2]Tactical Gear
[/h2]- Tactical Gear has been temporarily disabled.

[i]Dev's comment: Tactical Gear will be temporarily removed as we've received considerable feedback regarding them following the 24.1 Update. We're undertaking a thorough review to ensure Tactical Gear aligns better with our gameplay, focusing on acquisition methods and performance. Once we've refined these elements, we plan to reintroduce Tactical Gear to the game.
[/I]
[h2]Aston Martin[/h2]
- Fixed the issue where the vehicle flips and/or driving feels awkward when driving through certain areas, with the "V12 Vantage Roadster" Sports Car or "V12 Vantage Roadster (Luxe)" Sports Car skin equipped.
- (PC) Fixed the issue where the Vantage Paint (Cumberland Grey) is shown as Vantage (Luxe) Paint (Tayos Turquoise) after you initially equip the skin.

[h2]World: Miramar
[/h2]※ The following updates apply to every mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/9b365ba5de53bd69e44693e621c9cde5ba3f59e4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/241806bb8e24cfd4cdb7a4178bd7c8758738af03.jpg[/img]
- To promote a more balanced gameplay environment, we've adjusted some high ground areas to prevent players from gaining an unfair advantage when attacking from extremely elevated positions.

[h2]Danger Zones
[/h2]- Blizzard Zone and Sandstorm are now less likely to appear throughout the game. 

[h2]Modes[/h2]
[h3]Intense Battle Royale
[/h3]- TPP mode has been added.
ㅤ- FPP mode has been removed.

[i]Dev's comment: Following the initial release of Intense Battle Royale, we acknowledged the widespread feedback suggesting the implementation of FPP mode, and subsequently introduced it. However, after a thorough analysis of both internal data and global feedback, we decided to revert to TPP starting this update. We understand how such change might affect our diverse player base and we ask for your understanding as these experimental changes aim to enhance the overall gameplay experience. We remain committed to monitoring your feedback after this update, so that our future adjustments can be more flexible and in tune with your preferences.
[/i]
[h3](PC) Bluebomb Rush
[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/80aff6569dac139e490f5b630479e9a96d0c095c.jpg[/img]
- Shop Key Binding
ㅤ- You can now change the Bluebomb Rush Shop Key Binding which is currently set to "," key. 
ㅤ- The option above can be changed via "Settings → Key Bindings → Common → Spawn Tool".
- Map / Scoreboard
ㅤ- The default Key Binding for the map/scoreboard has been changed from two keys "M" and "Caps Lock" to a single key "M".
ㅤ- Two Key Bindings can still be configured via "Settings → Key Bindings → Common → World Map".

[h3](PC) Training Mode
[/h3]- You can now change the Spawn Tool keybinding that was previously set to the "," key.
- The option above can be changed via "Settings → Key Bindings → Common → Spawn Tool".

[h2]Progressive Weapon Skin System
[/h2][h3]New Skin Type: Chroma[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/d6b43b23588d5915ddad7cf7654d8cae39ea90a2.jpg[/img]
Presenting Chroma, a new type of skin that allows you to modify the color and effects of your Progressive Weapon Skins. Elevate the vibrancy of your weapon skin collection with this new addition!
- Chroma is a skin you can apply to Progressive Weapon Skins - it applies to the weapon skin, attachment skins, loot crates, and killfeeds.
- Obtaining Chroma:
ㅤ- Obtainable via the Hideout; further details on each Chroma skin can be found in our upcoming Store Update announcements.
ㅤ- Multiple identical Chromas can be obtained, the first of which will be locked upon acquisition.
- Applying Chroma:
ㅤ- Click on the obtained Chroma icon on the Hideout - Weapons page.
ㅤ- An applied Chroma will reflect every progressive level of the corresponding Progressive Weapon Skin.
ㅤㅤ- You do not need an individual Chroma per progressive level.
ㅤㅤ- Cannot be applied separately to specific progressive levels or attachments.
ㅤ- If you own multiple identical Chromas and apply Chroma to a Progressive Weapon Skin, the locked Chroma will be applied.
- Previewing Chroma:
ㅤ- Preview is available through Hideout - Weapons - Chroma icon.
ㅤ- Preview appears upon clicking the icon, regardless of owning the Progressive Weapon Skin or Chroma.
ㅤ- Preview displays Chroma applied to the corresponding Progressive Weapon Skin, reflecting currently unlocked progressive levels.

[h3]BATTLESTAT Skin
[/h3]- The BATTLESTAT skin for cumulative kills + headshots now features a new design.

[i]Dev's Comment: While the Progressive Weapon Skin system has been a great way to add variety to PUBG gameplay, our current collection of diverse Progressive Weapon Skins prompted us to consider a transformation that can take effect in the present and moving forward. We're unveiling the new Chroma skin, which can be acquired and applied regardless of the Progressive Weapon Skin's progressive level. With this new feature, we hope to provide even more customization options for your valuable Progressive Weapon Skins. Additionally, starting from Update 25.2, the BATTLESTAT skin will now showcase a fresh look for future cumulative kills + headshots skins.
[/i]
[h2]Performance[/h2]
[h3](PC) New Stability Improvement: GPU Debug 
[/h3]- Added two new options: "Collect GPU Crash Data" and "GPU Crash Report"
ㅤ- [b]Collect GPU Crash Data[/b] - Enable or disable the collection of GPU crash and related data including user crash dump files. 
ㅤㅤ- The option is disabled by default. 
ㅤㅤ- The option will be activated after enabling this setting and restarting the game. 
ㅤㅤ- The option may lower game performance due to stability checks and will be automatically disabled after 7 days of being enabled. 
ㅤ- [b]GPU Crash Report[/b] - Displays a pop-up window whenever multiple GPU crashes occur, prompting users to enable the "Collect GPU Crash Data" option.
ㅤㅤ- The option is enabled by default. 
- The options above can be enabled/disabled via "Settings → Gameplay →  Others → GPU Crash" options menu. 

[h3](PC) Default option: DirectX 11 → DirectX 11 Enhanced
[/h3]- For fresh game installations, "DirectX 11 Enhanced" is now the default option.
ㅤ- In other cases, the option has to be manually changed through "Settings > Advanced > DirectX Version > DirectX 11 Enhanced".
ㅤ- If a PC does not support DX11 Enhanced, DX11 will be set as the default option.
- DirectX 11 Enhanced is an option optimized for CPU performance, enhanced to support multi-threading during rendering.
ㅤ- DirectX 11 Enhanced offers similar stability compared to DirectX 11, but in some cases can lead to increases in FPS.
